transcript.text: AEG IKB64301FB induction hob keeps beeping and showing Er03 then switches off. Pan of pasta boiled over just before.

I can't confirm what ER03 means on your model, so I'll go by what it is doing. From what you have described, the most likely cause is the hob's cooling / ventilation. Next: If a spill or clean preceded it, let the hob dry fully before assuming a failed part. Let me know what you find.
There was starchy water across the slider, so I've wiped it dry. Is there anything else I should do before I try it again?
Next: Stop using it and isolate at the spur if there is any burning smell or scorching. Let me know what you find.
No burning smell or scorching. I've also switched it off at the wall for 5 minutes, and it works again now. Is there anything else I should check?
Good news, that has sorted it. If it happens again, start with the same check. Is there anything else I can help with?
